tier_definitions.V: raw independent verification artifact present in the scanned set (bareiss/bigint/tsverify/bigintaudit/verified/verdictverify/orbitverify)

tier_definitions.N: no certificate evidence found in the scanned set

conservative_notes: frontier and receipt recompute files are provenance-only: their WIN mentions are not counted as certificate evidence

interpretation_guard: solved 1452 is manifest cover bookkeeping of the head-1452 frontier; this census does not change any frontier number
